paper_problem.decision_variables: binary selection of turbine positions and balanced radial cable arcs/types
paper_problem.objective: maximize lifetime energy revenue minus foundation cost minus inter-array cable cost
constraints: one outgoing connection per selected turbine
radial strings ending at the fixed substation
cable flow no greater than cable capacity
cables remain outside obstacles and inside boundaries
paper_problem.wake: Jensen and Katic wake physics compressed to the cited Cazzaro-Pisinger pairwise power matrix

target_method.initialization: PDSP-inspired progressive removal followed by deterministic exact-cardinality spacing repair
target_method.initial_cable_routing: ten obstacle-aware balanced Sweep rotations with exact dynamic-programming enumeration for every at-most-six-turbine radial string
target_method.combined_local_search: selected-turbine 1-opt with local wake, foundation and incident-cable deltas; nearby 2-opt fallback including the shared-cable corner case
target_method.shake: move one to three nearby turbines using power-weighted counter-keyed candidate order while preserving feasibility
target_method.cable_recomputation: recompute balanced Sweep routing after each combined local-search or shake cycle
target_method.incumbent_rule: retain only feasible strictly higher-NPV solutions
